entityDescription:
Avia-GIS NV is a Belgian SME founded in 2001 that specializes in spatial risk mapping and modelling as a basis for the development of tailored spatial decision support systems (SDSS) and software packages applied to public-, animal- and crop health in general and integrated pest and disease management (IPM) in particular. We focus on the development of state-of-the-art techniques that broaden the scope of conventional analyses, convert data into new insights and bridge the gap between research and decision-making including: mathematical and spatio-temporal modelling, monitoring via earth observation through satellites and drones, wireless IoT sensor networks, and satellite navigation. In addition to our Software Products for risk mapping and integrated pest management, we offer a range of Consulting and Contract Research services to the industry, international organisations, governmental agencies, and research teams. These include: development of vector and disease transmission models to test what-if scenarios and support clinical trials, development of tailored SDS Systems and mobile applications; coordination of multidisciplinary research projects and networks, and à la carte on-site / on-line training and capacity building. Avia-GIS was growing steadily since 2001 and invested most of its increasing resources in human capital. Our experts are specialised in environmental engineering, biology, entomology, meteorology, spatial epidemiology, spatial modelling and ICT. The company has a unique market position. Only few companies operate in our domain and none developed such close contacts with the academic, decision support and industrial world. As a result we have a clear view on user needs and requirements, on the state of the art, and on how this can be translated into cost-efficient operational tools.
Avia-GIS NV is a Belgian company that employs 15 highly skilled collaborators from five nationalities of which one is a resident entomologist in Guadeloupe.
In addition Avia-GIS is owner of an independent daughter company in South Africa, Avia-GIS RSA Ltd. This company is specialized in eco-friendly integrated pest management for the hospitality industry.

entityDescription: EFTAS Remote Sensing Transfer of Technologies GmbH, is a private service provider specialized in the domains of Geoinformation and IT services. EFTAS realises sustainable solutions for its clients in industry and administration. EFTAS is based in Muenster, Germany, and is recognized since its foundation in 1988 among the German leading companies providing services in the following domains: • EFTAS.geoinformation Remote Sensing, Photogrammetry, Geostatistics, Mapping and Field observations • EFTAS.gis IT-Architecture, GIS- and Interface Development • EFTAS.webmapps Routing, Web Services, Web portal- and App-Programming • EFTAS.evolution Research, Studies, Technology- and Market development • EFTAS.consult Process Optimization, Knowledge Transfer and Training. Its clients comprise communal, national and international authorities as well as those from private industry. Whether for small communes, international government institutions or up to international or European institutions, EFTAS realizes special solutions adapted to the need of its clients by means of Geospatial information technologies (GeoIT). The success of EFTAS is based on the high quality of its products and services as well as the performance of the interdisciplinary team of EFTAS. EFTAS has managed projects in many countries all over the world and is since 2002 the leading service provider in Germany for the IACS Control with Remote Sensing (CwRS) framework and since 2007 in Europe for EC LUCAS Area Frame Survey applications. Based on its key staff of 66 employees at the headquarter in Muenster, more than 100 freelance experts, and a wide network of longstanding cooperation’s with professional partners abroad EFTAS disposes on a network of knowledge with its sectoral, regional and technical competences which constitute a service company of international format. EFTAS has established since 1997 its Quality Management System, which has been certified according to the standard DIN EN ISO 9001:2008 under the registration number 041009574 by TÜV CERT of the RWTÜV association in Essen, Germany.

entityDescription: Axcon is an independent, privately owned development house located in Denmark. We focus on advanced electronics, programmable logic (FPGA), and embedded software - in simple terms, we work with electronics and the software that runs inside of electronic devices. Axcon has history of successful cooperation with ESA/ESTEC/ESOC with the LISA phase meter development and the LLCD/LLOCL/LADEE laser communication/ranging development. We have four main revenue streams: * On-site consulting. Our consultants work onsite for our clients to assist in various tasks. * Outsourced development. We take over a project for the client and return the full development package and working products ready for production. * Technical courses for developers, engineers, and project managers. * Modules for rapid prototyping. These modules are produced by English Sundance Multiprocessor Technologies. The Customers Our customers range from large, multinational corporations to small, enterprising startups. Most of our customers are Danish companies with a focus in electronics development or require electronics development for their products. We have contracts throughout Denmark as well as in neighboring countries and abroad. We have worked for companies in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Germany, Austria, the USA, and we have even sent consultants to work abroad as far away as Korea. Products Axcon does not focus on developing our own products; rather, we focus on development contracts with regional and international corporations to create advanced solutions. Through a distribution agreement, we supply a range of advanced modules with FPGA, DSP, AD/DA technology. These modules are well-suited for rapid prototyping and small production series. Additional products provided include specific IP cores, software, and development systems. History Axcon was founded in 2004. We currently employ 12-15 predominatly engineers and we have partnerships with a large network of freelancers. Our employees work with our customers throughout Denmark as well as Denmark's neighboring countries. In 2009 Axcon was awarded the Danish "Gazelle Award" for exceeding 100% growth over a 5 year period. Management Axcon is owned by Anders Enggaard, who also is one of the two founders. Axcon was founded by two engineers with extensive backgrounds in electronics development and the international electronics community. Their expertise is focused in the American and Danish industries. Axcon is 100% self-financed and run without external ownership shares. Axcon is a private limited company.

entityDescription:
Top Modal is a Limited Liability Company (LLC) that offers studies, expertise, training and software tools in the field of structural dynamics since 2003. The goal of Top Modal is to provide solutions and know-how to the engineer so that he may solve his problems in the most efficient manner. As a small specialized company, Top Modal enjoys working in a close partnership with its customers – whether universities, engineering firms or industrial companies – spanning the aerospace, automotive, and marine fields
Top Modal is headed by Dr. Nicolas Roy, an expert in structural dynamics, optimization and robust design with over 30 years of industrial experience. With a M.S. from Caltech and Ph.D. from Penn State University, Dr. Roy worked at Lockheed Martin (Sunnyvale, CA) , ONERA (Toulouse) and Intespace (Toulouse) before founding Top Modal in 2003. Dr. Roy is also an instructor and lecturer at several universities and training centers in Europe and Asia, as well as co-author of the book Structural Dynamics in Industry available in English and French.

The company comprises only one person, Nicolas Roy, and therefore no organizational chart is provided

entityDescription:
EVOLEO Technologies, Lda. is a SME created in Jan 2007, investing in skills related to the design of critical and complex electronic systems. EVOLEO embraces four areas of activity:
•	Space (flight Hi-Reliability development, HW/SW, test and validation support activities)
•	Infrastructures (monitoring, knowledge extraction for decision support – railways/roads/energy)
•	Industry (quality control, test and automation systems)
•	Technology (specialized development of subsystems for 3rd party integration)

These four activity areas harmonise into three business areas:
•	Quality Support Systems (testing units for quality assessment labs, production lines)
•	Tangible Assets Management Support Solutions (solutions to monitor different kind of assets, providing management tools to the End User, to aid the decision-making process of investment or maintenance)
•	Technology (internal products for 3rd party integration or to embed into the other EVOLEO areas)

EVOLEO includes a skilled multidisciplinary engineering team seeking and promoting partnerships and networking between centres of knowledge and industry players, cooperating, among others, with European Space Agency (ESA), industry players and R&D groups, either National or International.

EVOLEO key skills are related to the design, build and integration of electronic embedded systems solutions for monitoring and data processing (Remote Interface Units). Those include integrated intelligence SW (embedded) for local data pre-processing or simply as transmitters of collected data to a central server.

EVOLEO has also skills in the implementation of multi-core systems (e.g. on FPGA) and has developed under an ESA project its own Computer Unit and its on-board controlling SW for a satellite payload control with LEON3 processor and real time OS RTEMS, involving key players of the computing solutions such Aeroflex Gaisler in Sweden. In other areas (framework of FP7 or national programs) the company integrates multiple data systems (vibrations, GPS, communications, data bases), apply data fusion to create operational SW tools to deal with the overall system and algorithms.

As fields of expertise one can refer:
On-Board Data Systems - Payload Data Processing, On Board Data Management, Microelectronics for digital and analogue applications
Space System Software (Space Segment Software, Ground Segment Software, Ground Data Processing)
Spacecraft Electrical Power (Power conditioning and distribution)
System Design & verification (Collaborative and Concurrent Engineering, System Analysis and Design, Verification & AIT)
Quality, Dependability and Safety (System Dependability and Safety)

EVOLEO provides engineering services covering a wide range of needs in the electronics design, embedded and systems engineering.
Design and Implementation of Analogue HW(Project, CAD, WCA, PSA, FMEA/FMECA)
Design and Implementation of Digital HW (Project, CAD, FPGA, µC/µP 8-32 bit - simple and multi-core over FPGA, VHDL and C)
SW Implementation for Embedded Systems (Real time operating systems, NI LabView platform, Windows or Linux environment)
Instrumentation, Automation and Control (PLCs, National Instruments technology)
Systems Engineering (Support to systems integration & validation)
Quality and Development Process (Support to ESA-ECSS standards)
